defaults.module: Plane / work collaboration and API governance
defaults.backend: complete: clean-room collaboration service over existing ProjectItem, ProjectComment, ProjectMember and StoredFile rows, with item restrictions, opaque cursor pages, allow-listed shaping and provider-neutral CSV import
defaults.frontend: complete: dedicated work-collab Operations route renders scope selectors, cursor navigation, CSV import, attachments, mentions, shared activity, shaped-item preview and restrictions; every control has one dispatcher guarded by test_ui_wiring.py
defaults.database: complete: five additive workspace-scoped tables created by Alembic revision d4e5f6a7b8c9 (collab_attachments, collab_mentions, collab_activities, collab_cursor_pages, collab_item_restrictions); no existing table altered
defaults.api: complete: one stable work-collab API group with generated OpenAPI 3.1 inventory, named operation ids and 400/404/409/422 failure modes; external_calls=false on local responses
defaults.permissions: complete: verify_workspace plus require(TASK_READ) for reads and require(TASK_WRITE) for writes; cross-workspace ids fail closed with 404; item restrictions hide unauthorized reads with 404 and refuse unauthorized writes
defaults.integration: complete: publishes collab.attachment_added, collab.mention_created, collab.team_note_created, collab.restriction_changed and collab.csv_imported to NOVARA's shared event spine; mentions add exact PlanningSubscriber rows for local notification recipients; no Plane source, Django transport, hosted endpoint, outbound HTTP or external import provider
defaults.remaining: None for this row. Other unimplemented, restricted or externally blocked rows keep their existing matrix status.

rows.remaining: None for provider-neutral CSV. External Asana/Jira importers remain separately blocked because no provider credentials or hosted API are claimed.
